title: Zendesk Knowledge Draft
description: Portable schema for Zendesk help-centre, support knowledge, FAQ, troubleshooting, known-issue, and internal knowledge article drafts.

title.description: Searchable article title written in customer language.

type.description: Article type selected from the skill's supported knowledge formats.

category.description: Topic area, product area, help-centre category, or internal support grouping.

audience.description: Who the article is for, such as customers, admins, billing users, support agents, or specialists.

visibility.description: Publication boundary for the draft. Use Needs decision when public/internal status is not confirmed.

tags.description: Searchable support tags, keywords, product terms, symptoms, or article labels.

body_markdown.description: Article body in markdown, excluding the metadata header and Publishing Notes.

source.description: Zendesk ticket, investigation, support note, pasted source, uploaded file, or other approved source material used as the source of truth.

existing_articles_to_update.description: Existing help-centre or internal articles that should be updated instead of, or alongside, a new draft.

public_internal_boundary.description: What is safe to publish publicly versus what must remain internal-only.

review_needed_from.description: Teams or roles that should review the draft before publication, such as support lead, product, engineering, legal, privacy, or security.

suggested_review_date.description: Specific review date, review trigger, or reason no date is needed.

recommended_next_route.description: Canonical zendesk- route when evidence, readiness, QA, customer reply, candidate review, explicit route-away, or router fallback is still needed. Use none when no next route is needed.
